PCA Loadings Biplot

Source: R/pca_plots.R
pca_biplot.Rd

A classic PCA biplot: the observation scores (pca_model$x) as a muted point cloud, overlaid with the variable loading vectors (pca_model$rotation) drawn as labeled arrows from the origin. Unlike plot_pca_bi, no separate newdata is required – a fitted prcomp object already carries both the scores and the loadings needed to draw the biplot.

Usage

pca_biplot(pca_model, x = 1, y = 2)

Arguments

pca_model

A prcomp object.

x, y

Which principal components to plot on the x/y axes (default 1, 2).

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Loading vectors are unit-scale by construction and would be invisible next to the score cloud if plotted as-is, so they are rescaled so that their maximum extent is 80 standard biplot convention) before being drawn.

Examples

pca_model <- prcomp(mtcars, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_biplot(pca_model, x = 1, y = 2)
